name: OMV Petrom S.A.
note: Listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (SNP). OMV Aktiengesellschaft holds 51.2%; the Romanian state, through the Ministry of Energy, held 20.7% at end-2025 (OMV Petrom shareholder-information page). Through OMV, the Austrian state (ÖBAG 31.5%) holds an indirect stake of about 16% and Abu Dhabi's ADNOC (24.9% of OMV) about 12.8%.
